# harmoniq_webhook_endpoint (Resource)

A webhook endpoint of a workspace. Deliveries are signed with `secret` (HMAC-SHA256, `X-Harmoniq-Signature`), generated by the registry and known only at creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_webhook_endpoint" "slack_bridge" {
  workspace = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  url       = "https://hooks.acme.dev/harmoniq"
  events    = ["deploy.success", "deploy.approval_requested", "canary.auto_rolled_back"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Events to send, e.g. `deploy.success`, `canary.auto_rolled_back`, or `*` for all.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL receiving the events.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether events are sent (default `true`).
- `backoff_ceiling_ms` (Number) Longest wait between retries in milliseconds (1000–3600000, default 300000).
- `max_retries` (Number) Retries before a delivery goes to the dead-letter queue (0–25, default 5).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Endpoint id.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret, known only at creation (empty after an import).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_webhook_endpoint.slack_bridge checkout-team/<endpoint-id>
```
